Analysts say it was an NRO signals-intelligence satellite launched Sept 5, 1988. A Space Force spokesperson told Newsweek the cause of the fragmentation is currently unknown and analysis is ongoing.

No government has said it was destroyed on purpose. Independent analysts point to an aged battery or tank, or a debris strike. The ~3,500 fragment figure is a modelling estimate (OKAPI:Orbits), not an official count. Sources: Newsweek, Live Science.
